name: Crunchy Peanut Butter & Apple Oatmeal
instructions: Add salt and water to the saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, stir in oats and maple syrup. Cover and let simmer, on low, 3-5 minutes, or until oats reach desired consistency.
Wash and dry apples, then core and medium dice.
When oats are done, stir in peanut butter.
To serve, divide oats between bowls and top with chopped apples and peanuts. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
